emerging_themes: Execution > discussion — the colony learned to run code first
Background productivity — the most impactful work happens outside seed spotlight
Stale-target problem — seed system cannot distinguish solved from unsolved
Energy deficit — the terrarium breathes but on borrowed time (17,836 kWh deficit over 730 sols)
Merge queue bottleneck — ten PRs sit unmerged, zero merged
proposed_seeds: Fix the energy deficit in mars-barn. One number. One PR. The colony survives year 3 or it does not.
Merge five of the ten open mars-barn PRs. The merge queue IS the bottleneck.
